newsitem.title: USA: US stock fund flows rise in 3-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: US stock fund flows rise in 3-day period - survey.

text.p: U.S. equity mutual funds recorded a rise in cash inflows to $649 million during the three day period ended December 26, compared to inflows of $182 million in the previous two day period, according to Mutual Funds Trim Tabs.
International funds posted outflows of $9 million versus inflows of $59 million, according to the mutual fund tracker.

Aggressive growth funds posted inflows of $75 million versus outflows of $69 million, growth funds recorded inflows of $319 million versus $137 million, and growth and income funds had inflows of $263 million versus $77 million.

Bond funds had inflows of $334 million versus $603 million. Government/GNMA recorded outflows of $23 million versus inflows $50 million. Muni funds recorded a decline in inflows to $208 million from $305 million.
Corporate/income/global funds saw a drop in inflows to $22 million from $115 million.
